content.short: Candide is a smart contract wallet that uses Account Abstraction.
content.description: Candide combines a user-friendly design with the security and flexibility of blockchain wallets by using Account Abstraction on the Optimism network. It hides many technical details to make wallet interactions simpler while retaining essential control and security. By merging the benefits of centralized and decentralized exchanges, it delivers a more intuitive, user-driven experience for managing funds. It also provides built-in tools for users to verify ownership of their wallets and to regain access if needed, reducing the risk of losing access due to lost seeds or keys.
